interpretationRules: An approved original work in another module is not automatically an exact-slot signoff.
A checked proposal with a narrower user-written destination cannot override that destination.
Accepted alternatives are not rotated or published automatically.
User contextual reuse permissions are preserved, not rejected for failing literal event matching.
Original October 28/30 review and all original artwork IDs remain authoritative.
Do not infer a global veto from a rejected placement; preserve explicit exception scopes.
All artwork files need separate rights, identity, native crop and mobile QA.
